notes.single_entry: Verified single-entry, one-day events at The Venetian. Each row is taken from the official DeepStack Extravaganza IV schedule and its official structure sheet (the structure number is listed). The structure sheet shows no re-entry, rebuy or add-on. Late registration is allowed and is not treated as a second entry.
notes.excluded: Not ranked as single-entry. Includes re-entry/rebuy/add-on events, multi-flight events (1A/1B/1C... where more than one flight can be played), and satellites that award seats rather than cash prizes.
notes.unverified: Official schedule row exists, but the structure sheet was not reviewed, so re-entry/add-on/flight status is UNVERIFIED. Values are copied from the official schedule only. Blank means not stated on the official source.
